diagram_math_checks.check: The bottom label H(s,0)=gamma_0(s), top H(s,1)=gamma_1(s), and fixed side labels H(0,t)=A, H(1,t)=B agree exactly with local def-homotopy-relative-and-path-homotopy Definition and carrier L1. A and B are the common initial and terminal endpoints, explicitly defined in Remarks.

Step 2.1 lists the four corner images in lower-left, lower-right, upper-right, upper-left order. The separate right panel joins these four labeled images by directed straight chords in precisely a,b,c,d,a order. All four edges, including d to a, are explicitly drawn and visibly present. The schematic shape asserts neither injectivity nor nondegeneracy nor planar orientation, as explained in the caption.

Carrier step 2.1 puts all four corner images in the same convex disc D_jk and therefore every drawn segment lies in D_jk. The figure does not assert that H takes parameter edges to these straight chords; the Remarks explicitly distinguish the construction from H(partial Q_jk).

For adjacent Q_jk and Q_(j+1)k, b_jk=a_(j+1)k and c_jk=d_(j+1)k directly from the coordinate formulas in step 2.1. The left cell traverses the common edge upward, b_jk to c_jk; the right cell traverses it downward, d_(j+1)k to a_(j+1)k. The two offset arrows show those opposite orientations; step 4.1 with L6 cancels their equal-and-opposite chord integrals.

The four boundary arrows are counterclockwise in parameter coordinates: bottom rightward, right upward, top leftward, left downward. Thus bottom chords form forward P_0 and top chords reversed P_1, exactly as step 4.1 states. Side vertex images are all A or all B by L1, so side chords are constant. Step 4.2 independently equates chord integrals with original boundary-path integrals using primitives.

The 3-by-3 grid is expressly schematic, not a restriction on the proof choice of N. The unchanged proof derives all equalities without the illustration; the Remarks explicitly state proof independence.
